cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. This tap gives you whatever you ask for. Ask for tea while I hold a cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not using my good china for that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll hold a saucepan. You ask.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm not tasting anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for a biscuit instead. If one comes out, we won't need your tongue as equipment.

mechanism: A makes its pupil perform the first test of a wish-granting tap, grading equipment caution and adapting the requested output to avoid tasting.
confusable: Not simply pursuing proof itself: A holds the vessel but insists B make the risky request.
comparison: Protecting china and avoiding tasting versus probing and loading a hidden surface.
seedUse: D152 tap/tea/china/saucepan/biscuit; S05 old test-equipment lessons.
